scenes.title: SUM
scenes.narration: SUM adds up the numeric values in a column, the backbone of totals and revenue reports.

scenes.title: Adding values
scenes.narration: SUM adds together all the numeric values in the column you give it. NULLs are simply skipped, so they do not distort the total. Combined with GROUP BY, it produces subtotals for each category in one query.

scenes.title: Revenue per region
scenes.narration: GROUP BY organizes orders into one group per region. SUM then adds every order amount within each group. The alias total_sales labels the resulting revenue figure for each region.

scenes.title: How SUM aggregates
steps: Group rows if GROUP BY is present
scenes.narration: When a GROUP BY is present, SUM works within each group separately. It ignores NULL values and adds up the rest. The result is a single total for the whole set, or one total per group.

scenes.text: SUM turns rows of numbers into meaningful totals, quietly ignoring NULLs along the way.
scenes.narration: Use SUM to total numeric columns, remembering that NULLs are skipped automatically so they never inflate or corrupt the result.
